_reason_redundancy_TEST_MATRIX_and_matri: First baseline, 2026-08-24: scripts/gate_common.py's segment_units() used to skip every line starting with '|' outright, so the redundancy precheck never saw a single TEST_MATRIX.md/matrix/*.md row's content — this ran the check against these files for the first time, table delimiter rows still skipped but data-row cells now scanned. No cleanup was attempted here; the count is dominated by the matrix genre's own templated fixture-description phrases repeating verbatim across many rows ('red proven against the pre-fold text...', 'the pre-delta tree...'), not necessarily paraphrased-requirement duplication the way PRODUCT_SPEC.md's floor tracks. A companion audit (docs/prover/2026-08-24-matrix-retired-rows.md) found most of the *retired* TEST_MATRIX rows cannot currently be archived out of matrix/*.md without breaking tests/test_traceability.py::test_matrix_covers_every_anchor, so this baseline should not be assumed to shrink soon.
